mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to prepare a site for a tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Site preparation costs vary widely based on the land's current condition and the required utilities. Expenses can include grading and leveling, trenching for water and sewer lines, electrical hookups, and potentially septic system installation if municipal sewer isn't available. Foundation costs, whether slab, pier, or skid, are also a significant factor. Expect costs to range from a few thousand dollars for basic utility connections on an already prepared site to tens of thousands for extensive excavation, septic, and a robust foundation on undeveloped land.
acceptedAnswer.description: Site preparation costs range from thousands to tens of thousands, depending on land condition, utility needs (water, sewer, electricity), and the type of foundation required.
